Claude Code Game Studios

Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio.
49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team.

--- ## Why This Exists Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" **Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work. React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

* **Declarative:** React makes it painless to create interactive UIs. Design simple views for each state in your application, and React will efficiently update and render just the right components when your data changes. Declarative views make your code more predictable, simpler to understand, and easier to debug.
* **Component-Based:** Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them to make complex UIs. Since component logic is written in JavaScript instead of templates, you can easily pass rich data through your app and keep the state out of the DOM.
* **Learn Once, Write Anywhere:** We don't make assumptions about the rest of your technology stack, so you can develop new features in React without rewriting existing code. React can also render on the server using [Node](https://nodejs.org/en) and power mobile apps using [React Native](https://reactnative.dev/).

[Learn how to use React in your project](https://react.dev/learn).

## Installation

React has been designed for gradual adoption from the start, and **you can use as little or as much React as you need**:

* Use [Quick Start](https://react.dev/learn) to get a taste of React.
* [Add React to an Existing Project](https://react.dev/learn/add-react-to-an-existing-project) to use as little or as much React as you need.
* [Create a New React App](https://react.dev/learn/start-a-new-react-project) if you're looking for a powerful JavaScript toolchain.

## Documentation

You can find the React documentation [on the website](https://react.dev/).

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](docs/i18n/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](docs/i18n/README.ja.md) · [한국어](docs/i18n/README.ko.md) · [Français](docs/i18n/README.fr.md) · [العربية](docs/i18n/README.ar.md) · [Türkçe](docs/i18n/README.tr.md)

A small Python CLI and portable agent skill for calling OpenAI's text, image, transcription, and cost APIs. Generate text or an image, or transcribe a recording, then keep the request ID, returned usage, and output paths together in a metadata file.

## Contents

- [Capabilities](#capabilities)
- [Curated models](#curated-models)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Credentials](#credentials)
- [Agent integration](#agent-integration)
- [Outputs and billing](#outputs-and-billing)
- [Documentation](#documentation)
- [Development](#development)

## Capabilities

- **Generate text** through the Responses API with four curated models, reasoning controls, and token limits.
- **Generate images** with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst or Flare, with size, quality, quantity, and format controls.
- **Transcribe files** with GPT-Transcribe, including multiple language hints and domain keywords.
- **Inspect cost records** using an organization admin credential, scoped to a project and optionally an API key and model.
- **Automate through JSON**: API execution results use a consistent success flag and process exit code.
- **Keep useful evidence**: successful media calls save request IDs, usage, HTTP status, elapsed time, and response metadata.

# Mika **你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。** 它在一块看不见的后台屏上干活，你照样刷你的手机。 An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you — on a hidden background screen, so you can keep using your phone. [下载 APK](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [能做什么](#能做什么) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献) 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)
> **English summary** > > Mika is an Android app that takes a one-sentence request and carries it out on your phone. It drives apps on a private background screen (so you can keep using your phone), browses the web in a built-in desktop-class browser, and runs scripts in a local Linux sandbox. You bring your own model API key (several providers are supported as presets, plus any OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic or Gemini endpoint). There is no Mika server: your requests go only to the model provider you configure. > > Status: **public beta**, changing quickly (see [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases) for versions and changes). Install on Android 11+, tasks need Android 13+, Android 14+ recommended. The sandbox runs on arm64 devices only. The app UI is available in English and Chinese (follows your system language; switch in Settings › Language); see the [full English README](README.en.md). Licensed under Apache-2.0. ## Beta 说明 - 这是早期公开测试版，功能和界面还在快速变化，升级时可能有不兼容的改动。 - 目前主要在一台安卓 14 手机上测试过。别的安卓版本、别的手机上可能遇到没见过的问题，欢迎[反馈](#参与贡献)。 - Mika 会替你操作第三方 App 和网站，请先读[免责声明](#免责声明)。 ## 演示

candidates.description: A plugin marketplace for GitHub Copilot and other AI agents that provides Power Platform development plugins, including reusable skills, agents, and commands for building and deploying solutions.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Power Platform Skills

Official agent skills/plugins for Power Platform development by Microsoft.

## Overview

This repository is a **plugin marketplace** containing GitHub Copilot/Claude Code plugins for Power Platform services. Each plugin provides skills, agents, and commands to help developers build on the Power Platform.

## Installation

### Quick Install (Recommended)

Run the installer to set up all plugins with auto-update enabled:

**Windows (PowerShell)**:

```powershell
iwr https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/power-platform-skills/main/scripts/install.js -OutFile install.js; node install.js; del install.js
```

**Mac OS/Linux/Windows (cmd)**:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/power-platform-skills/main/scripts/install.js | node
```

The installer automatically:

- Installs `pac` CLI if not already installed
- Detects available tools (GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code)
- Registers the plugin marketplace and installs all listed plugins except `dataverse`
- Enables auto-update so plugins stay current

The installer validates plugin names in local and downloaded marketplace manifests before
installation. Names must follow the Open Plugins format: 1–64 lowercase ASCII letters or
digits, with single dots or hyphens allowed between alphanumeric endpoints. CLI arguments
are passed directly to executables; Windows batch launchers accept only shell-inert arguments.

To also install the [Dataverse](#dataverse-external) plugin, pass `--include-dataverse`:

```powershell
iwr https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/power-platform-skills/main/scripts/install.js -OutFile install.js; node install.js --include-dataverse; del install.js
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/power-platform-skills/main/scripts/install.js | node - --include-dataverse
```

The `-` tells Node to read the piped script, so the arguments after it reach the installer.

### Manual Installation

If you prefer to install manually, run these commands inside a GitHub Copilot CLI or Claude Code session:

1. Add the marketplace

    ```bash
    /plugin marketplace add microsoft/power-platform-skills
    ```

2. Install the desired plugin

    ```bash
    /plugin install power-pages@power-platform-skills
    /plugin install model-apps@power-platform-skills
    /plugin install pcf@power-platform-skills
    /plugin install mcp-apps@power-platform-skills
    /plugin install code-apps-preview@power-platform-skills
    /plugin in

`cedr` is the command line tool behind [cedr.dev](https://cedr.dev). It picks which AI coding agent, model and effort should take each kind of work, merges reviews from several vendors into one pass or block decision, and pins the skills and MCP servers your agents load. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini, and any agent that speaks MCP can call it directly. > [!NOTE] > cedr is in preview. candidates.description: A low-poly 3D office that shows your AI coding agents' live status — idle agents sneak off to play Minecraft (no tokens used).
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Agent Office 3D

把你的 AI Coding Agent 變成一間 3D 辦公室裡的員工：誰在工作、誰閒著、誰卡在權限確認，一眼就看得到。閒著的員工會去倒咖啡、上跑步機、摸貓，或是偷玩 Minecraft。

Turn your AI coding agents into staff in a little 3D office. See at a glance who is working, who is idle and who is stuck on a permission prompt. Idle staff grab coffee, hit the treadmill, pet the cat, or sneak in a round of Minecraft.

[English](#english) ・ Built with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ・ Made by SparCode studio

![示範員工閒置時偷玩 Minecraft：兩台螢幕是各自機器人的第一人稱畫面，最後是螢幕特寫](docs/screenshots/office-minecraft.gif)

> 畫面都是示範模式（demo），員工、任務、專案和金額全部是虛構的。

## 用 AI Agent 安裝

下載這個 repo 後，在資料夾裡打開你的 AI Coding Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor…），直接貼上這句話：

```text
請讀這個 repo 的 AGENTS.md，幫我把 Agent Office 裝好並打開麥塊示範。
```

Agent 會照 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 先跑 `npm run doctor` 檢查環境，再幫你安裝、啟動示範，並詢問要不要接 Herdr、怎麼客製公司名稱和員工。安裝 Node.js、Java 這類系統軟體前，它會先問你；Minecraft EULA 一定要你自己輸入 `yes`，Agent 不會代為同意。Claude Code 使用者也可以直接輸入 `/setup-office`。

## 快速看麥塊

不用接自己的 Agent，兩個指令就能看到示範員工偷玩 Minecraft（需要 Node.js 20 以上、Java 21 以上）：

```bash
npm ci
npm run demo:minecraft
```

第一次執行會先跑 `minecraft:setup`：檢查 Java、請你同意 Minecraft EULA、從 Mojang 官方下載伺服器並驗證。產生世界約 1～2 分鐘，機器人進世界後自動打開瀏覽器，幾秒內就會有員工開始玩。按 `Ctrl+C` 停止，世界會先存檔。

**為什麼要你自己輸入 `yes`？** Minecraft 伺服器軟體屬於 Mojang，執行前必須由使用者本人同意 [Minecraft EULA](https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA)。這個 repo 不能也不會替你同意，所以不附任何 Mojang 檔案，也不會跳過這一步；你不同意的話，就不會下載任何東西。

只想看辦公室（不需要 Java）：`npm start`。

⭐ 覺得有趣的話，歡迎幫這個 repo 點個星星，讓更多人看到！
⭐ If you find this fun, a star on the repo would mean a lot!

## 功能

- **員工即時狀態**：每位 Agent 一個座位，狀態燈與名牌顯示「工作中／閒置／完成待命／需要確認」。需要確認時名牌變紅、頭上冒驚嘆號。
- **看終端畫面**：點員工可以看他最近的終端輸出（只讀，不能從這裡下指令）。
- **閒置時的小動作**：倒咖啡、喝水、跑步機、伸懶腰、打瞌睡、偷玩內建小遊戲；有開 Minecraft 的話，螢幕上是他自己的 Minecraft 機器人第一人稱畫面。
- **布告欄**：年度目標、KPI、本週重點、現金流、待辦清單。點布告欄會飛過去打開全螢幕介面，待辦可以直接勾選。
- **書架＝專案資料庫**：每本書是一個專案資料夾，點了可以看裡面的 Markdown 文件和截圖（只讀）。
- **任務清單**：右側列出任務資料夾裡的檔案，點了看全文。
- **一隻貓**：在走道散步、趴睡、跳上空桌。

| 布告欄 | 書架專案介面 |
|---|---|
| ![布告欄首頁：現金流與年度目標](docs/screenshots/board.png) | ![書架：專案資料庫](docs/screenshots/bookshelf.png) |

## 需求

- **Node.js 20 以上**（必要）
- **Java 21 以上＋ Minecraft Java 版伺服器**（選用，只有想讓員工玩 Minecraft 才需要）
- 一個支援 WebGL 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Safari、Firefox）

支援平台：macOS、Linux。**Windows 為實驗性支援**：CI 會在 Windows 上跑安裝、語法檢查與示範模式測試，但作者沒有 Windows 實機驗證過，Minecraft 在 Windows 上也還沒實測。

## 安裝與啟動

### macOS／Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jefferysha0627/agent-office-3d.git agent-office-3d
cd agent-office-3d
npm ci
npm start
```

### Windows（PowerShell）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/jefferysha

# Code Animation Prompts **从一句创意，到一段有风格的代码动画。** 341 种风格提示词 · 193 张参考静帧 · 10 个系列 · Claude Code & Codex Skill [![Styles](https://img.shields.io/badge/styles-341-b7f47b?style=flat-square&labelColor=161d28)](docs/STYLES.md) [![Stills](https://img.shields.io/badge/reference_stills-193-86b7ff?style=flat-square&labelColor=161d28)](docs/images/style-gallery.png) [![Skill](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent_Skill-Claude_Code_%26_Codex-e6ceaa?style=flat-square&labelColor=161d28)](skills/code-animation-prompts/SKILL.md) [![Sharing](https://img.shields.io/badge/sharing-free-ecb7cc?style=flat-square&labelColor=161d28)](LICENSE.md) [浏览全部风格](docs/STYLES.md) · [一键导入](#一键导入claude-code--codex) · [手动安装](docs/INSTALL.md) · [原始示例](skills/code-animation-prompts/assets/library/示例) · [来源与许可](LICENSE.md)
## 先看风格 粒子、霓虹、水墨、剪纸、漫画、电影感……把喜欢的画面交给 AI，再用代码把它动起来。 ![12 种风格的真实参考静帧](docs/images/style-gallery.png) 以上图片来自素材包自带的参考静帧，编号与提示词一一对应。**193 种有图，148 种为文字参考**；静帧展示视觉方向，实际动画取决于内容、实现和渲染结果。 | 想做什么 | 可以从这里开始 | |---|---| | 温暖的粒子叙事／片头 | **B3** 粒子聚形、**B2** 萤火光尘 | | 国风片头／节日短片 | **Z5** 剪纸、**Z1** 水墨、**Z8** 敦煌 | | 科技感／赛博城市 | **R1** 霓虹雨夜、**R5** 像素赛博、**R6** 东方赛博 | | 科普／知识讲解 | **M1** 白板手绘讲解、**L10** 工程方案比较墙 | | 漫画短片／有冲击力的表达 | **R3** 美式漫画、**X7** 英雄漫画 | | 杂志式排版／电影视觉参考 | **H1** Biennale Yellow、**O** 系列 | ## 它包含什么 | 组成 | 你可以用它做什么 | |---|---| | **完整原始素材库** | 阅读 341 份 Markdown 提示词，查看静帧、参考实现与原始示例 | | **离线风格挑选器** | 搜索、按类别筛选、放大图片、勾选风格、导出已选清单 | | **可安装 Agent Skill** | 让 Claude Code／Codex 按需读取风格，规划镜头并制作代码动画 | | **轻量检索脚本** | 按编号、关键词、系列查找；不必把整个素材库塞进上下文 | | **浏览器渲染工具** | 将提供时间接口的 HTML 逐帧导出为 MP4，可混入已有音频 | | **一键导入提示词** | 复制到有本地文件和终端权限的 Claude Code／Codex，完成下载与安装 | ## 一键导入：Claude Code / Codex **复制下面整段，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex：** ```text 请将 https://github.com/XiaoyeCodes/code-animation-prompts 安装为当前编程助手可用的 skill。 1. 将仓库下载到合适的本地目录；若已有同名目录，先检查内容，不覆盖已有改动。 2. 阅读 README.md、docs/INSTALL.md 和 skills/code-animation-prompts/SKILL.md。 3. 根据当前助手选择安装目标：Codex 使用 ~/.agents/skills/code-animation-prompts， Claude Code 使用 ~/.claude/skills/code-animation-prompts。 在仓库根目录运行 python scripts/install_skill.py --target codex 或 --target claude。 如果当前助手无法确定，只向我确认目标；不要擅自安装到两个位置。 4. 安装时保留完整 skill 文件夹，包括 assets/library 中全部提示词、静帧、HTML、 示例视频和许可文件。若目标已存在，保留现有目录并报告，不自动删除或覆盖。 5. 执行已安装目录中的 scripts/styles.py search 水墨，确认可查到风格； 再执行 scripts/styles.py show B3，确认能读取完整提示词。 6. 告诉我实际安装路径、如何调用，以及是否需要新开会话。 最后给我一句可以直接使用的

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# /carrossel

Skill para Claude Code e Codex que cria carrosséis com a cara da sua marca: do roteiro ao PNG em 2x, com galeria, slider, comparação de versões e legenda pronta.

![Prompt solto vs. /carrossel](docs/antes-depois.png)

## Por que não é "só um prompt"

O que deixa um carrossel bom não é o prompt, é o processo:

1. **Roteiro antes do visual.** A IA propõe a copy slide a slide e só desenha depois do seu ok.
2. **A galeria é a referência.** Cada peça aprovada vira referência para a próxima, então o estilo se mantém.
3. **Assets próprios.** Uma série de imagens no estilo da marca, gerada com image gen a partir de uma âncora aprovada.
4. **Checagem visual.** Cada slide é renderizado e conferido antes de chegar em você.
5. **Gosto acumulado.** Toda recusa ou aprovação vai para um `GOSTO.md`, que a skill lê antes de cada peça. Quanto mais você usa, mais ela acerta.

## Funciona para

- **Marca que já existe:** a skill lê seu site, logo e posts e monta o manual a partir deles.
- **Marca do zero:** faz algumas perguntas, propõe 2 ou 3 direções e monta a identidade com você.

## O que você recebe

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Galeria](docs/galeria.png) | ![Slider](docs/slider.png) |
| **Galeria** com todas as peças e versões | **Slider** com legenda, comparação e download em alta |

Cada slide sai em HTML editável, PNG 1080×1350 e PNG 2160×2700.

Vídeo de 24s: [`docs/motion/lancamento.mp4`](docs/motion/lancamento.mp4)

## Instalação

Requer Node 18+.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/guilhermealvestech/carrossel-skill
cp -r carrossel-skill/skills/carrossel ~/.claude/skills/carrossel   # Claude Code
cp -r carrossel-skill/skills/carrossel ~/.codex/skills/carrossel    # Codex
npm install --prefix ~/.claude/skills/carrossel
npx --prefix ~/.claude/skills/carrossel playwright install chromium
```

Se o `npm install` mostrar um aviso de `allow-scripts`, pode ignorar.

Depois, no seu projeto: peça um carrossel ("faz um carrossel sobre ...") ou rode `/carrossel`. Na primeira vez a skill monta a pasta `carrosseis/` e faz o onboarding da marca.

## Estrutura

```
skills/carrossel/
  SKILL.md                 o workflow
  references/              onboarding, roteiro, visual, image gen, entrega

# Ansible

Ansible is a radically simple IT automation system. It handles
configuration management, application deployment, cloud provisioning,
ad-hoc task execution, network automation, and multi-node orchestration. Ansible makes complex
changes like zero-downtime rolling updates with load balancers easy. More information on the Ansible [website](https://ansible.com/).

## Design Principles

* Have an extremely simple setup process with a minimal learning curve.
* Manage machines quickly and in parallel.
* Avoid custom-agents and additional open ports, be agentless by
  leveraging the existing SSH daemon.
* Describe infrastructure in a language that is both machine and human
  friendly.
* Focus on security and easy auditability/review/rewriting of content.
* Manage new remote machines instantly, without bootstrapping any
  software.
* Allow module development in any dynamic language, not just Python.
* Be usable as non-root.
* Be the easiest IT automation system to use, ever.

# Ajan Ofisi

Claude Code ajanlarını 3D bir ofiste gösteren yerel arayüz. Her ajan bir masada oturan bir kedi; iş gelince uyanır,
çalışırken ekranında ne yaptığı görünür, bitince çıktısı "CEO soruyor" kartına düşer ve kedi yeniden uyur.
Boştayken hiçbir model çağrılmaz: **0 token**.

![Ajan Ofisi demo modu](docs/ekran.png)

- **Arayüz:** three.js ile prosedürel 3D ofis (fotoğraf ya da model dosyası yok), tıklanınca meme pozuna geçen kediler,
  oda/ajan panelleri, canlı akış, token sayacı, Web Audio ile küçük sesler, demo modu.
- **Sunucu:** yalnız Python standart kütüphanesi, yalnız `127.0.0.1`. Ajanları `claude -p` ile koşturur.
- **Bağımlılık:** Python 3.10+, [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code) (`claude` komutu), `tmux` (yalnız ofisten görev verirken; kendi oturumlarını izlemek için
  tmux gerekmez, düz terminal, VS Code ya da masaüstü uygulaması da görünür).
  Ön yüz three.js'i CDN'den (unpkg) yükler.

## Hızlı deneme (hiçbir şey bağlamadan)

```bash
cd on-yuz && python3 -m http.server 8000
# tarayıcıda: http://127.0.0.1:8000/?demo=1
```

`?demo=1` arka uca hiç istek atmaz; örnek ajanlar (`on-yuz/demo-veri.json`) kendiliğinden iş alıp bitirir.
Alt kutuya "blog taslağı yaz" gibi bir şey yazarsan sahte CEO işi uygun ajana dağıtır. `?oto=0` otomatik koşuları
kapatır, `?hafif=1` düşük çözünürlük ve küçük gölgeyle çizer. (Ön yüz ES modülü kullandığı için dosyayı çift tıklayıp
`file://` ile açmak çalışmaz; yukarıdaki gibi basit bir sunucu yeter.)

## Kendi ajanını nasıl bağlarsın

1. **Yapılandırmayı kopyala.**
   ```bash
   cp ajanlar.example.json ajanlar.json
   cp kopru.example.json kopru.json      # isteğe bağlı: terminal köprüsü
   ```
   `ajanlar.json` ve `kopru.json` `.gitignore`'dadır; yolların ve prompt'ların repoya girmez.
2. **`cwd` ve hazır görevleri yaz.** Her ajan için `cwd`'yi gerçek proje klasörüne çevir (`~` kullanabilirsin),
   `hazir_gorevler` içindeki `<buraya kendi prompt'unu yaz>` yerlerini doldur, `izinli_araclar`'ı en dar hâlde tut.
   `ayarlar.kullanici` selamlamadaki ad ("Günaydın Ayşe."), boş bırakırsan yalnız "Günaydın.".
   Klasörü olmayan ajan "kurulmadı" sayılır ve koşturulmaz.
3. **Sunucuyu başlat.**
   ```bash
   python3 sunucu.py            # http://127.0.0.1:8796, doluysa sonraki boş port (./port dosyasına yazılır)
   tmux attach -t ofis          # koşan ajanları canlı izle (her koşu ayrı pencere)
   ```
4. **Tarayıcıda aç:** `http://127.0.0.1:8796`. Bir kediye tıkla → pa
